name: How long does it typically take to install a new bathroom countertop?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a new bathroom countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most bathroom countertop replacements take one to two days for on-site physical installation, excluding the initial templating and fabrication lead time. Once custom slabs like granite, marble, or quartz are cut, our crew sets the surface, levels it over your vanity, and secures it. However, the overall project duration often includes plumbing reconnects and any adjoining tile or backsplash work. Because HH Remodeling manages sub-trades for plumbing alongside our in-house finish carpentry and tile crew, we coordinate sink cutouts, faucet hookups, and wall repairs back-to-back to prevent unnecessary downtime in your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Physical installation takes one to two days once the slab is fabricated. Reconnecting plumbing and installing backsplashes may add another day to finish the space completely.
